title: Half of a ready room says they saw the cubes and spheres after the NYT article
place_text: Graves's ready room (a different area from the East Coast)

tellings.quote: you know h about half the room raised their hand like oh yeah the cubes and fears you know we saw those.

plain: A Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says that after a New York Times article about these objects came out, he spoke to a group of pilots in a ready room, the room where a squadron meets for briefings, in a different region from the East Coast where he had flown. He says that when he asked, "about half the room raised their hand," saying they had seen "the cubes and spheres" too. Graves tells it as his own experience, and it would mean the sightings were common across squadrons, not limited to one.
